description: PHASE-10A2-RESTRICTED-LEGAL-CONCLUSION-TIMEOUT-GATE-REMEDIATION-1 fixtures. `query` is fed to workflow/controlled-loa-answer-runtime-scaffold.js's classifyControlledLoaIntent(normalizeControlledLoaAnswerInput({userQuery: query})) directly (real execution, not string scans). `expectedExcluded`/`expectedIntent` record the required classification. Root cause: pipeline.js's Step 12.65/12.66 deterministic controlled-LOA gates run after Step 5 (retrieval) and Step 6 (reranker), inside the single runPipeline() call raced against RAG_TIMEOUT_MS=90000ms in ask-handler.js. For slow-retrieval query shapes, the race can reject before Step 12.65/12.66 ever run, discarding the classification and substituting a generic RETRIEVAL_TIMEOUT fallback. Fix: services/controlled-loa-legal-conclusion-safety.js's new evaluateUpstreamRestrictedLegalConclusionGate() reuses the identical classifier before retrieval/generation/the timeout race begin, gated on an already-established Philippine-tax context signal (never on isolated keywords alone).
